title: First Smile
desc: That tiny gummy grin melted everything. We argued for ten minutes about whether it was real or just wind — it was real.
story: You were lying on Mum's chest, just after a feed, and you looked up with the sleepiest, most content expression. And then — a smile. It lasted maybe two seconds but it felt like the whole world stopped. Dad was convinced it was wind. Mum knew better.
